strings.en: Dad!
Oh, Akira... Have you been well?
Yes, Dad... I got your message. Is it true!?
That Mom... was in Tibet!?
Yes, Akira. No doubt about it... The temple ruins convinced me.
A temple? You mean... the ruins in Tibet?
Yes. When the ancient continent of Mu was destroyed... many clay tablets
are said to have been carried from there
to a certain temple in Tibet...
Tablets... about the Star of La Mu!?
Yes. Just before we reached Tibet, locals saw a lovely, mysterious woman
dig through the temple ruins, find several tablets,
and leave with them.
Mom... It really is Mom! So where is she!?
...The sea.
The sea? ...That's not much to go on.
The tablet with the exact location... your mother probably has it,
with Reiko.
From what I found, she seems to have headed for the waters near Japan...
I understand, Dad. I'll go look for...
Wait, Akira. It isn't all good news.
D-Don't tell me...
I'm afraid so. ...The Demon Empire is on the move again...
After Prince Sharkin... So is it the king's turn now?
His name is... Demon Emperor... Barao...!
Demon... Emperor... Barao!?
What...? Akira's mother, whom we have long sought... Reiko Hibiki...
no, Lemuria, descendant of the hated Mu Empire... You've finally found her!?
Yes, as you commanded...
While we watched the movements of Akira Hibiki's father in Tibet...
we at last found a lead.
And... where is this Lemuria now?
She seems to be headed for waters near Japan, seeking something.
No doubt... the key to unleashing Mutron energy,
the Star of La Mu, has been found...
The Star of La Mu?
Lord Barao... if Reiko Hibiki... if Lemuria obtains this Star of La Mu
and unleashes Mutron energy...
We... will be destroyed...!
Impossible!
I... can't believe it...!
Perhaps the likes of Sharkin, but you, Demon Emperor Barao,
and we Kyoretsu Brothers as well!?
Sadly, it is the truth.
Then we must catch this Lemuria as soon as we can...!
Exactly...! If we do not capture Akira's mother, we shall perish!
Yet if we seize that power for ourselves...
this Demon Empire will have no equal!
Yes, sire!
Leave it to us, Lord Barao...!
Lord Gades.
What is it, Diondra?
Please send me to Earth.
Have you found where the Hyper Libido... no, the Mutron is?
There's a so-called Demon Empire after that treasure called Mutron.
If we make use of them, perhaps...
The Demon Empire... Yes, that may be a good idea.
By the way, what of Gardy and the others who sortied earlier?
I sent them to the rendezvous point with the Bunker...
So I'm to join them first, then head to the surface?
No. Descend to the surface ahead of them and seize the Mutron.
Outmaneuvering the Bunker, then...
They don't yet know where the treasure is...
As long as Gardy and the others join them, they'll have no complaints, hm?
As expected of you, Lord Gades...
Take Devil Saturn 6 and descend to the surface.
Gadessa!
Emperor Muge... what exactly is the Einst's goal?
Oho...
That I reveal myself before these humans like this
is because of the Einst...
I see.
But that alone will not satisfy me...
(Nor me... And to become a god, I alone will be enough...)
The Mykene headquarters is on Bardos Island?
Is that true, Professor?
Yes, no doubt about it... Our survey team found it by chance.
Bardos Island... Koji, isn't that where your grandfather...
Yeah... It's where he dug for ruins with Hell, long ago.
Hell? You mean THE Dr. Hell?
...While studying the ancient Mykene robots he'd unearthed, Dr. Hell...
apparently came up with the idea of using them to conquer the world...
Temptation got the better of him, huh? Good grief.
Koji's grandfather, Dr. Juzo Kabuto, saw through that ambition...
and built Mazinger Z.
So that's what happened...
Now that we know, we can't just sit around!
Let's hurry up and head for Bardos Island!
What are you saying, Koji!?
You'd abandon the people at the Cyber Beast Force base!?
Oh... right.
It's true that now we know where the Mykene headquarters is,
perhaps we should rush there, but...
Still, if they aren't about to make a move right away,
I'd rather we check on the base first...
Have the Mykene been on Bardos Island for a long time?
No... We recently surveyed odd crustal activity around Bardos Island
and happened to discover their base...
It's a phenomenon unseen for years, so whether it's long been their base...
Even if they only gathered there for now... their bosses are there?
...Tetsuya.
I can't say for certain... but most likely...
...Commander!
Where... should we be heading...?
The silence from the Cyber Beast Force base is worrying, but...
in truth... we've also received word on the Demon Empire.
The thing is... Mutron ruins were discovered in Japan,
and it looks like my mother is there...
Well, that's great... Is there some kind of problem?
Akira's mother... seems to know the secret of Mutron,
and the Demon Empire is apparently making moves to get it.
...And it's the Demon Empire's boss... Demon Emperor Barao's men...
That's terrible... Then we need to go look for her right away.
Yeah, it'd be a disaster if she fell into enemy hands.
But... it's not as if we know exactly where she is...
And I'm worried about the situation elsewhere too... I can't impose on you.
If we head for Japan... Bardos Island is the other way, isn't it?
Bardos Island is in the Mediterranean, right, Father?
Yes, that's right. Their headquarters lies beneath it.
We go to Japan first, stop at the Mutron ruins and Cyber Beast base,
and then Bardos Island seems reasonable...
Maybe we don't need to rush in and attack them ourselves...
I... am going to Bardos Island.
Tetsuya!?
Tsurugi...
Jun and I have trained hard to defeat the Mykene Empire...
If you won't head to Bardos Island first, we'll act on our own from here.
Charging alone into the enemy's headquarters is far too dangerous...
Defeating the Mykene is my mission. I won't let anyone object.
Tetsuya! ...Commander Hazuki, I'm sorry... I'm going too!
Tsurugi... Hono...
Tetsuya!
...Koji, it's no use trying to stop me. I'm going.
I'm sorry, Koji.
I didn't come to stop you, Tetsuya. ...I'm coming too.
Koji...!
No.
Tetsuya!? That's not fair! I want to avenge my grandpa too!
...If you leave as well, what happens to this ground force?
...Ugh.
The force is already split up as it is.
How much difference a single Mazinger Z makes...
Don't tell me you don't understand that, Koji.
Something's happening at the Cyber Beast Force base too.
Go there for them, Koji.
I'll hold out at Bardos Island until you all arrive.
Tetsuya... So that's why you...
Heh. I'm just selfish, as always. ...Let's go, Jun!
